text: Rituals||Weave dark magic and seduction across the world through Morathi and her Sorceresses.

Through her court, Morathi weaves dark magic and seduction across the world. Manipulations cost Manipulation; Dark Magic is free. Each action needs a character of the required level to perform it: Morathi performs her own rituals (Shadow Walk, Establish Cult and Cataclysm), and Sorceress heroes perform the rest. Pick an action, then the character to perform it, then its target.
